transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Most nights I end up eating until I feel uncomfortably full, even though I keep telling myself to stop earlier. It's started happening so often lately that I realized I really need some help figuring out how to stop.
After these episodes of eating a lot, do you ever try to make up for it by vomiting, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot?
No, I don't do any of those things at all. I've never tried to make myself throw up or use laxatives, and I don't fast or over-exercise afterward either.
How long has this been happening, and on average how many days per week do these episodes occur?

This has been going on for about four months now, starting around the time my wife took on her extra evening shifts and classes. It happens at least a couple of nights every week on those nights when I'm home by myself.
During these episodes, do you feel a strong fear of gaining weight or feel very distressed about your body shape or weight?
To be honest, I haven't really thought about my weight or body shape during those times. I'm mostly just focused on how physically uncomfortable and bad I feel after eating so much.
Do you have a strong fear of gaining weight or a lot of concern about your body shape or weight outside of these eating episodes?
No, I don't really have a strong fear of gaining weight or worry too much about my body shape. My main struggle is just how physically uncomfortable and ashamed I feel after these eating episodes.
When these episodes happen, do you feel like you lose control and eat much more than you intended, or is it more that you are eating large amounts because you are alone, stressed, or bored?

It’s actually a mix of both. While it usually starts because I'm home alone and bored, once I get going, I feel a complete loss of control. It’s like something takes over where I keep telling myself "this is the last bite," but my hand just keeps going back for more anyway.

Have you ever been underweight or had a period when your eating was mainly restricted because of fear of gaining weight or wanting to be thin? This helps me tell whether this is a binge-eating pattern versus another eating disorder.
No, I've never been underweight or had a time where I restricted my eating because of a fear of gaining weight. That's just not something I've ever experienced.

Outside of these episodes, do you usually eat normal meals, or do you also spend a lot of time restricting food, skipping meals, or feeling unable to eat? Also, how much is this affecting your daily life or causing distress?

No, I don't restrict food or skip meals at all, and I usually just eat a normal dinner before this starts. However, it's really impacting my life because I've been turning down social invites with friends just to plan these solo food nights. Afterward, I feel so bloated, sluggish, and ashamed that I can't even focus on my chores or my drawing.
Have you ever had a period of significant weight loss, very low body weight, or strict food restriction that was driven by a fear of gaining weight or a desire to be thinner?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have never had significant weight loss, strict food restriction, or any fear of gaining weight.
Have you ever had any other eating-related behaviors or symptoms, such as eating non-food items, chewing and spitting, or episodes of eating very little because of low appetite or feeling sick?
No, I have never experienced any of those behaviors. I've never eaten non-food items, chewed and spit out food, or had periods where I ate very little due to a low appetite or being sick.
When these episodes happen, do they involve eating an objectively large amount of food in a short period of time, and have they been occurring at least once a week for the past 3 months?

Yes, I definitely eat a massive amount of food in a really short time. I'll stand in the kitchen and eat what feels like three meals' worth of sandwiches, leftovers, and chips in the time it would normally take to have one regular meal. This has been happening at least a couple of nights every week for about four months now, starting when my wife's schedule changed.
During these episodes, do you feel a sense of loss of control and distress about the binge eating itself, or is it mostly just eating more than usual without feeling distressed or out of control?

I definitely feel a strong sense of loss of control while it's happening, like something else takes over and I can't stop reaching for food even when I try. Afterward, I feel a lot of distress and shame, especially when I realize I've gone way too far again and end up physically uncomfortable.
Have you ever had any compensatory behaviors after these episodes, such as vomiting, laxative use, fasting, or excessive exercise, or is it only the binge eating without those behaviors?

No, I don't do any of those things like throwing up, using laxatives, or exercising to make up for it. After these episodes, I actually feel so bloated and sluggish that I just end up crashing on the couch.
Have you ever intentionally tried to lose weight or change your shape by dieting, skipping meals, or restricting food between these episodes, even if it was not severe?
No, I've never really tried dieting, skipping meals, or restricting my food to lose weight or change my shape. That's just not something I've ever done.
Do these episodes happen at least once a week and leave you feeling significant distress, or are they more occasional overeating episodes without much distress?

Yes, they happen at least a couple of nights every week, lining up with my wife's evening schedule. It is definitely not casual overeating—it causes me significant distress and leaves me feeling physically uncomfortable, sluggish, and deeply ashamed afterward, to the point where I've started sneaking food so my wife doesn't see.
Just to confirm, have you ever had any periods of purging, fasting, or strict dieting because of concern about your weight or body shape, even briefly?
No, I've never done any purging, fasting, or strict dieting. I have never engaged in those kinds of behaviors or had those concerns about my weight or shape.

Have you ever had any other eating disorder diagnosis or treatment in the past, such as anorexia, bulimia, or another specified eating problem? This helps me tell whether this is a specific binge-eating disorder pattern or a more general eating disorder diagnosis.

No, I've never had any past diagnoses or treatment for eating disorders like anorexia or bulimia. This is actually the first time I've ever experienced this kind of eating pattern or sought help for it.
